sentences.en: Hello. Learn English with me while I show you my trip to Thailand. Starting with our.
sentences.tc: 你好。當我向你展示我的泰國之旅時，和我一起學習英語。從我們的開始。

sentences.en: When I was on an extreme budget, I would buy the cheapest tickets?
sentences.tc: 當我預算有限時，我會買最便宜的票嗎？

sentences.en: I could find. And once I had a 50hour flight with a 12hour layover in Los Angeles,.
sentences.tc: 我能找到。有一次我搭乘了 50 小時的航班，在洛杉磯停留了 12 小時。

sentences.en: Then an 8hour layover in Japan. That was a brutal flight. I think once you're on hour 13 on a plane, that's.
sentences.tc: 然後在日本轉機8小時。那是一場殘酷的飛行。我想一旦你在 13 點搭飛機，那就是了。

sentences.en: When you're just like, "Where am I?" That's when you lose all notion of time?
sentences.tc: 當你問：「我在哪裡？」那是你失去所有時間概念的時候嗎？

sentences.en: How do you cope with long flights? I try to sleep through them, of course. But I'm curious, what other strategies?
sentences.tc: 您如何應付長途飛行？當然，我會嘗試在它們的影響下入睡。但我很好奇，還有什麼策略呢？

sentences.en: Do you have to cope with long flights?
sentences.tc: 您必須應付長途飛行嗎？

sentences.en: I love nighttime flights because the lights are so pretty and purple and blue. I can sleep all through them. After our 30 hours of traveling,.
